scope: Offline static repair of the fixed-build native MCM bridge and removal of the legacy F1 settings overlay. No game launch, injection, or live process inspection.

iggy_callback_abi.analysis: Static x64 disassembly of the pinned DLL with Visual Studio dumpbin; the DLL was not loaded.

callback.return_register: EAX; nonzero follows the handled path
callback.boolean_representation: low 32-bit integer 0 or 1 in Value+16; upper 32 bits are unspecified by the converter

iggy_callback_abi.implementation_guard: The bridge only accepts the pinned DLL hash and exact export RVAs. It forwards all non-MCM callbacks to the original callback and accepts Boolean payloads only in the SetOption value slot, only for 0 or 1.

bridge_initialization_incident.evidence: Mcm-native-23036.log confirms every construction attempt reaches StatusCode checkpoint 101 after language RPC but never reaches checkpoint 102 after Vector.<dropdown_option> construction. The original PopulateSettingsCategory method installs this and newactivation on its scope stack before constructing Vector; the injected prefix previously ran before that prologue.
bridge_initialization_incident.root_cause: The Iggy callback installation race has been resolved, but the remaining native page construction failure is unresolved. Exact RPC sequence is required to locate the failing ActionScript operation.
bridge_initialization_incident.fix: Entry 0.2.3 retained its verified method-scope prologue. Entry 0.2.4 corrects the external dispatch name so language operation 14 reaches SoD2SE_Mcm_v1. MCM 0.6.3 uses this read-only result to select Chinese/English labels and removes the manual language dropdown. Offline build and package parsing pass; blank-page runtime acceptance remains pending.

limitations: The user previously confirmed that Settings → Mod Settings opens, but the page body remained blank. The 0.6.3-preview / 0.2.4-preview language-detection rebuild has only static validation and remains unverified in-game; the blank-page issue remains open.
The previous saved runtime logs verify only Iggy ABI readiness; they do not prove the callback hook or RPC was installed/reached.
F1 no longer opens the legacy MCM settings overlay in the new DLL. A process that already loaded the older DLL retains it until fully exited and restarted.
Keyboard/gamepad focus, page layout, option writes and persistence require in-game acceptance.
